services.desc: UPDATE: have added pricing for single-class drop-ins for parents whose schedule is unpredictable Earlier this year, the dojo put out a survey, to which a number of you responded positively to the possibility of a class geared for parents ie more towards health and fitness than traditional karate. As such I’m pleased to announce that the Sat 12:30pm All Adults class will be restructured as Mobility for Health. The change will occur in 2 weeks on Sat September 27th. The class is intended to be accessible to parents of karate students, including those whose do not engage in regular exercise.
